response.answer: Explainable AI in MRI diagnosis focuses on hierarchical occlusion and ensemble methods to improve interpretability, with emphasis on evaluation metrics, reproducibility, and regulatory compliance. Grad-CAM and Integrated Gradients are popular techniques. Hybrid models and post-hoc methods enhance diagnostic accuracy.
